Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of our SIG/SOC2 evidence intake we need a short-run export of admin activity and operator logs for a scoped audit. High-level asks below — can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated handoff timeline?

Scope: 30-day window (2025-04-18 to 2025-05-18)
Events of interest (minimum): admin login/logout, role/grant changes, api-key creates/deletes/rotations, model rollout actions (version pin, canary), dedicated pool scaling events, privilege elevation/assume-role, session termination, console console-auth failures, and operator CLI actions.

Requirements:
- Export format: one of Parquet or JSONL, with a manifest.
- Cryptographic integrity: SHA256 checksums for each file and a signed manifest.
- Timezone: normalize timestamps to UTC and include original tz offset if available.
- PII: scrub user display names and email local-parts unless explicitly requested; provide mapping file with hashed identifiers (salted).
- Chain-of-custody: attest to any redaction steps and provide who performed the export (name & role).
- Delivery: secure S3 (us-west-2) or SFTP — prefer S3 with customer-side KMS wrapping if available.

Can you also include a small sample (first 500 records) within the next 48 hours for format verification? We can provide a signed NDA if you need it.

Laura
Security Operations, CedarBridge

2) Export size & format: for 30 days that scope will likely be ~1.2–1.8 GB compressed in JSONL; Parquet will be smaller and faster to ingest. We'll attach an export-options-matrix with cost/time estimates.

We use AWS KMS for envelope encryption; by default the bundle will be encrypted at rest and in transit with TLS. If you require customer-managed keys (CMKs), we can perform a customer-side wrap via a pre-agreed KMS key.

4) Delivery and chain-of-custody: we support S3 (pre-signed PUT to your bucket), SFTP, or a secure transfer to a Redwood-managed S3 with cross-account role. We will include a chain-of-custody statement and an audit attestation signed by our compliance lead.

Laura / Mina — added technical detail below for the sample and final export.

What we log (relevant events):
- auth.login, auth.logout, auth.failed, api_key.create, api_key.delete, api_key.rotate, role.assign, role.revoke, model.rollout.start, model.rollout.complete, model.pin, pool.scale.up, pool.scale.down, privilege.elevate, privilege.drop, session.terminate, cli.exec (commands & result codes), console.2fa.change.

Fields included per event (export): timestamp_utc, local_timestamp, event_type, resource_id, actor_id_hash (salted SHA256), actor_display (redacted), actor_email_domain, ip_address (first two octets redacted for PII), region, request_id, request_payload_hash (if applicable), kv_diff (when role changes), node_id, model_version_before, model_version_after, raw_event_json (optional, compressed).

Retention & sampling: admin activity is retained internally for 540 days. For exports we can produce a full 30-day snapshot or an incremental delta (daily deltas with a baseline). For evidence requests a full snapshot is typical; if you prefer incremental we can do a signed daily bundle with monotonically increasing sequence numbers.

Export formats supported: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) gzipped, Apache Parquet, or columnar Avro. Manifest format is JSON containing file list, SHA256 checksums, record counts, byte sizes, and export UTC timestamp. We also include an HMAC over the manifest (SHA256) signed with our export key; if you require a PKI signature we can provide an X.509-signed manifest via our compliance team.

Timezones & timestamps: we will normalize to UTC and retain a local_timestamp field if available from the event source. All timestamps are RFC3339.

Encryption & key handling: default: server-side encryption with AWS KMS (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:alias/redwood-export). Optionally we can do customer-key-wrap where you provide a temporary public key and we encrypt the bundle key with it before upload.

Delivery: options & lead times:
- Pre-signed PUT to your S3: sample in 24-48 hours; full 30-day bundle in ~48–72 hours (depending on size).
- Cross-account role to your S3: requires 1-day IAM exchange; then ~24 hours once role is accepted.
- SFTP: 48–96 hours depending on queue.

Costs: small one-time export handling fee for cross-region egress may apply; we'll put a line item in the export-options PDF.

I'll prepare the 500-record sample in JSONL gzipped and include the manifest/checksum.

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
